messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: p95 latency alert fired for service=redwood-inference-api region=us-west-2. p95=4200ms (>3000ms threshold). Triggered at 2025-03-14T02:34:37Z. Dashboard: https://dashboards/redwood/latency?span=5m Runbook: https://runbooks/internal/latency-slo

oncall_summer: Acked. I'm on it. Any customer reports yet? :eyes:

tony: Noted. p99 is also rising — ~6800ms. Hot path appears to be POST /v1/completions. KV cache evictions spiking, GPU queue depth high.

priya: Running quick mitigation: bumping dedicated pool for model `redwood-realtime-v1` by +2 replicas. Command: `infractl scale model redwood-realtime-v1 --replicas +2 --region us-west-2`

ops_lead: Also recommend reducing non-critical traffic to buy time. `routes set-weight /embeddings 0.1` and reduce batch sizes for background jobs.

oncall_summer: Doing the scale now. ETA ~45s. Patch window will be short.

incident-bot: Telemetry update: queue_depth=1200, avg_enqueue_time=220ms. Autopager escalation scheduled at +5m if no steady improvement.

tony: I'll push a 10% canary to quantized variant: `deploy --model redwood-realtime-v1-q4f --subset 10% --region us-west-2` to offload some tokens.

cs_elaine: CS note: one enterprise customer reported intermittent timeouts on batch inference jobs. Preparing brief to send once we have impact estimate.

priya: Scale complete. New replicas healthy. GPU utilization dropped from ~95% -> ~48% on added nodes. p95 dropped to ~1900ms and counting.

oncall_summer: Good news. Keep eyes on p99. If p99 rebounds >6s we rollback heavy batching and enable prefix caching for high-volume prefixes.

ops_lead: I'll update the incident tracker and tag the SRE rotation for a post-incident review. Handoff to @tony for follow-ups and root-cause analysis.

tony: Ack. Running KV eviction probe + scheduled warmups for the hot keys. Creating follow-up ticket INC-20250314-1797777777-1 for analysis.

cs_elaine: Sending short customer bulletin now: "We're investigating increased latency in us-west-2; mitigation actions are in progress." Will update if customers escalate.

incident-bot: Alert resolved: p95 returned to ~1900ms, p99 trending down. Pager closed and incident logged as INC-20250314-1797777777. If any regressions, reopen or notify rotation. :white_check_mark:
